Blood drinkers.text: The blood drinker is a stranger at the threshold, and the old rule holds that it must be let in. In Wisborg [Ellen reads that only a pure-hearted woman's blood, freely given, can hold Count Orlok|1922-nosferatu], while the town fills with deaths blamed on a plague from his ship. In Santa Carla [Michael drinks from a bottle of blood in a buried hotel|1987-the-lost-boys] and begins to shun the light, and in Bali [Cathy's head tears free and flies off after a midnight meeting in the graveyard|1981-mystics-in-bali]. The fear is strongest in the oldest films, carried by 7 of the 41 made before 1960.

Creatures and contagion.text: Here nature itself spreads and takes over, through a monster or a sickness that will not stay where it began. In Seoul [a creature born of the poisoned Han River carries Hyun-seo down into the water|2006-the-host], and on the express to Busan [the dead surge through the carriages|2016-train-to-busan] with every bite turning another passenger. In the Tsitsikamma forest [fungus-covered people stalk Barend's wooden house at night|2021-gaia] while mushrooms sprout from living flesh. The fear turns up in every era, from King Kong to Godzilla Minus One, and reaches seven regions of the world.

Cults and curses.text: This nightmare belongs to the group that turns on you, the dark god behind it and the cursed thing passed from hand to hand. In a Freiburg dance academy [Suzy learns the school was founded by a woman said to be a witch|1977-suspiria], and on a remote Welsh island in 1905 [a goddess lies bound in tree roots in a barn, fed on blood|2018-apostle]. [A bagua mirror found on a bus takes a soul for every stroke of Joy's good luck|2004-feng-shui]. It is rising fast, from 1 of 41 films made before 1960 to 26 of 147 made since 2015.

Doubles and impostors.text: The fear here wears a familiar face, something that takes a person's place so well that no one can be trusted. In Antarctica [MacReady trusts no one once the thing proves it can perfectly imitate any living thing|1982-the-thing]. Beside an Irish forest [a neighbour's old book tells Claire of fairies who steal babies and leave changelings|2015-the-hallow], and in Derry [a creature in a storm drain wears each child's worst fear|2017-it]. Half of its 36 films were made since 2015, so this is a nightmare that has grown sharply in recent years.

Greed and its price.text: Wealth and ambition are bought here with someone else's life, and the bill always comes due. The Le Domas fortune rests on a great-grandfather's deal, so [on her wedding night Grace draws Hide-and-Seek from the puzzle box|2019-ready-or-not] and her in-laws take up weapons to hunt her before dawn. On Elm Street [Nancy learns the parents once burned Fred Krueger alive|1984-a-nightmare-on-elm-street], and now he hunts their children in their sleep. The fear is most at home in the 1960s and 70s, with 8 of its 26 films, from House of Usher to The Legend of Hell House.

Hungry love.text: Love and hunger share a bed here, and desire wakes something old that feeds. In a Stockholm suburb in 1982 [Oskar and Eli tap coded messages through their shared wall|2008-let-the-right-one-in] while Håkan kills to bring Eli blood. In Bad City [a young woman in a chador resists Arash's exposed neck|2014-a-girl-walks-home-alone-at-night], and in a Mexican barn [a tentacled creature from a crashed meteor gives Veronica a pleasure no man can match|2016-the-untamed]. It has no films before 1960, yet its 19 reach from Sweden and Iran to Mexico and Senegal.

Killers and captives.text: Here the danger is a person who kills, and the trap is a place with no way out. At the Bates Motel [a shadowy figure with a kitchen knife finds Marion in the shower|1960-psycho]. In a sorority house [Jess learns the obscene calls are coming from inside the house|1974-black-christmas], and at an Austrian lake [two polite young men hold Georg's family hostage through one long night|1997-funny-games]. With 63 films it is the largest of these nightmares, present in every era, and it is strongest in Continental Europe, at 17 of 77 films.

Places that swallow you.text: Some places take people in and never give them back, a house or a rock or a ship that leads to the other side. Beneath Hanging Rock [Miranda, Marion and Irma walk in a trance into a crevice in the stone|1975-picnic-at-hanging-rock], and at her aunt's country house [a piano bites off fingers as the house begins to eat Gorgeous and her friends|1977-house-hausu]. In orbit around Neptune [the stranded crew of the Event Horizon begin to see the people they failed|1997-event-horizon]. None of its 46 films comes from before 1960, yet it reaches nine regions of the world.

Possession.text: Possession begins with an invitation, a spell or a game that opens a way into a life and lets something take it over. In Georgetown [Regan finds a spirit board and talks with someone she calls Captain Howdy|1973-the-exorcist], and in Adelaide [teenagers grip an embalmed hand and say I let you in|2022-talk-to-me]. In the rain-cursed village of Tumbbad [Vinayak lowers himself on a rope to steal gold from the starving god Hastar|2018-tumbbad]. The nightmare is strongest in Southeast Asia, carried by 10 of 33 films there against 21 of 223 in North America.

The changing body.text: Here the body turns against its owner, changing its shape and its hunger, often around birth and growing up. Irena believes [she will become a panther if roused to passion|1942-cat-people], so she never consummates her marriage. At veterinary school [Justine is made to swallow a raw rabbit kidney during hazing|2016-raw] and a hunger that runs in the family takes hold, while at a Malaysian girls' school [Zaffan's first period arrives and her nails start to fall away|2023-tiger-stripes]. Its films have multiplied lately, with 15 of its 37 made since 2015.

The mind turns.text: This is the fear of a mind that turns on itself, and of the power others hold over it. On the island of Baltrum [Johan Borg sketches the Birdman and the Meat-Eaters through sleepless nights|1968-hour-of-the-wolf] while his pregnant wife Alma sits up with him. In a Mexican circus [the boy Fénix watches his father cut off his mother's arms|1989-santa-sangre], and years later his arms become Concha's hands as she orders him to kill every woman he desires. From The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari to Saint Maud, it turns up in every era.

The restless dead.text: The dead here return because they were wronged, and they will not rest until the wrong is answered. In Allahabad [Hari Shankar finds his own face in a photograph that falls from the palace wall|1949-mahal], and in Chanderi [men stay indoors after ten while Stree takes them and leaves only their clothes|2018-stree]. In a suburb of Dakar [the unpaid men lost at sea return inside the bodies of the living|2019-atlantics]. It lives mostly in Asia, carried by 13 of 33 films from Southeast Asia and 9 of 16 from South Asia, against 11 of 223 from North America.
